verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 102.2 (-1.4% in a day) and momentum is 37: prices are falling. 84s cost 850, 85s 2,000 and 86s 4,700. Midweek is usually the quietest time to buy cards for the weekend.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-10-12T18:19:00+01:00}}.

moves.title: Buy Kadidiatou Diani 87 after its 18% fall, sell in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 19,250 coins. Now 19,500. Buy the dip: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often recovers part of the fall within two days. Picked because it is down 18.1% in about a day. This is the strategy's first tracked call. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Quiet midweek: plan your weekend squad now
moves.detail: Midweek is usually the cheapest time to buy cards you will play at the weekend. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-10-15T07:59:00+01:00}} and add fodder supply.

moves.title: Fodder: 85s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 850 (1.02 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,000 (0.95 coins per Item Score point), 86s 4,700 (1.15 coins per Item Score point), 87s 6,000 (1.09 coins per Item Score point), 88s 11,750 (1.42 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 85s then 84s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Ayden Heaven and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Ayden Heaven 75 Rare -29.0%; Rafael Márquez 88 Base Hero -28.5%; Jérémy Jacquet 77 Rare -27.5%; Josh Acheampong 75 Rare -20.0%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: 5x 80+ Upgrade SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 7.6K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
